pages.transcription:
31.7.41

Ossining.

Dear Hanna, dear Manfred, I can only add a few lines today
being busy with supervising Eva's writing, knitting typing
and the maid's first try to make potato salad (still a special
treat for your child). I had her come here yesterday, for I
had Elizabeth for tea who came with husband and her two
children. I like them, and Eva who is invited to spend a
few days with them the week after next will certainly
enjoy herself, once the two girls have given up her very great
politeness of the beginning. - We are working hard and Eva
had to help too, sorting out a few chapters. At the pace at which
Stefan is working I could use Ursula as well. - I am glad that
parcel arrived. I only sent one more, containing chocolates and
cocoa, about 6 weeks ago to London, and a small one to Ursula
and mother each. It is not possible to send cigarettes as far
as I know, also not fresh fruit. - I hope it will soon be
decided whether we stay or travel south again. Stefan will
fell[?] much better once things are settled.
Love to all, Lotte.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf weißem Papier. Die Tinte ist dunkelblau/violett. Die Lesbarkeit ist sehr gut.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar. Das Wort 'fell' in der vorletzten Zeile ist orthographisch vermutlich als 'feel' gemeint, wurde aber diplomatisch als 'fell' transkribiert, da es so geschrieben steht.
